source.note: 1992 Topps flagship baseball. TCDB is the checklist and rookie-card authority. The 792-card flagship was issued in one series. VCS models the standard 15-card, 36-pack box configuration. Topps Gold and Match the Stats are included because they were inserted in packs; Gold Winners and pre-production/promotional issues are excluded because they were mail-in or promotional releases rather than normal pack pulls.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Mirror the standard 1992 Topps 15-card pack and 36-pack box configuration.
decisions.baseStructure: One 792-card Base ProductSet, #1-792, issued in one physical series.
decisions.baseAvailability: All 792 flagship cards use equal VCS availability for completion and prestige tracking.
decisions.goldStructure: Topps Gold is modeled as an explicit 792-card ProductSet rather than a derived parallel because six base checklist numbers were replaced with different player cards in Gold. For the standard 15-card pack format, Gold was inserted 1:36 packs.
decisions.matchTheStatsStructure: Match the Stats is a 52-card physically unnumbered pack insert set, inserted one per pack. VCS assigns deterministic sequence numbers 1-52 and records Physical NNO in Variant. White-back and gray-back print variations are intentionally collapsed to one logical collectible per subject.
decisions.excludedRelatedIssues: Gold Winners is excluded because it was obtained by mail-in redemption of Match the Stats game pieces. 1993 pre-production samples and panel/promotional issues are excluded from the normal pack product. Gold factory-set-only bonus #793 is excluded because it was not a standard pack pull.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Append RC only to TCDB-recognized true rookie cards. The base rookie index contains 61 records. Gold cards retain RC when they correspond to those recognized rookie card numbers; Gold-specific checklist replacement subjects are not given RC unless independently recognized by source data.
decisions.variationHandling: Ignore print-code, copyright-line and similar manufacturing variants unless they define a materially different checklist subject. One logical VCS collectible is kept per card number within Base and Gold.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains the clean card subject plus compact collector abbreviations only. Error/variation descriptions and other source metadata do not appear in Player.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Set-wide insertion odds live only on ProductSets. Card Variant never stores 1:n odds.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pack imagery, card imagery and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-792, one series, equal VCS availability.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: Explicit checklist because six base checklist cards were replaced with different players in Gold. Standard 15-card pack insertion ratio 1:36. Factory-set-only #793 excluded.

productSets.name: Match the Stats Game
productSets.notes: 52 physically unnumbered game cards inserted one per pack. VCS uses deterministic sequence numbers 1-52 and collapses white/gray-back print variants.
